risks.risk: Hidden cracks/leaks at the bottom, around the rim, or along side seams not visible from this distance/angle.
risks.proof: Request a close-up video of 1 drum: rotate it slowly showing the full circumference and bottom, plus a quick water-fill/soak test clip (or leak test with water).
risks.if_unproven: Price as used plastic water drums with possible minor defects (assume not guaranteed leak-free).

risks.risk: Lid seal quality (gasket/locking) may be missing or worn, causing future leakage/contamination.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the lid underside and rim/gasket area for at least 2 drums, plus a clip showing the lid fully seated/locked.
risks.if_unproven: Price as drums with lids present but seal not guaranteed (assume may need replacement/extra sealing).

risks.risk: Capacity/size unknown (price depends heavily on whether it’s 20L/25L/50L/100L/200L class).
risks.proof: Ask for the exact volume per drum (liters) and a photo showing any size marking/sticker on the drum.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the worst-case for value among common sizes (assume smaller/less valuable capacity).

risks.risk: Food-grade status not proven; drums may have previously held non-food chemicals or may not be certified.
risks.proof: Request documentation or clear label/stamp on the drum indicating food-grade/NSF or similar, and photos of that marking.
risks.if_unproven: Price as non-certified used plastic drums (not food-grade guaranteed).

proof_requests: Exact drum capacity (liters) and a photo of any size marking/sticker on the drum.
Close-up photos of one drum: full side seam, bottom, and lid rim/gasket area.
A short video showing the drum rotated to confirm no cracks and a lid fit check.
If possible: a water-fill or leak-test clip for one representative drum.
response.reason: The photos confirm plastic drums with lids, but key pricing drivers (exact capacity and verified food-grade/leak-free condition) are not provable from the single distant image. Missing these means a worst-case price would be too speculative without the decisive markings and close-ups.
